54667.subject: Technical Drawing
54667.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
54667.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center and radius greater than half of AB, draw arcs above and below AB.
3. With B as center and the same radius, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label all points (A, B, C, D) and construction lines clearly.

54668.subject: Technical Drawing
54668.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with a side length of 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
54668.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius = 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F around the circumference.
4. Join the points A, B, C, D, E, and F to form the hexagon.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

54669.subject: Technical Drawing
54669.question_text: Construct a tangent to a given circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm from the center of the circle. Show all construction lines.
54669.explanation:
1. Draw the given circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Join O and P.
4. Construct the perpendicular bisector of OP to find its midpoint M.
5. With M as center and radius OM, draw a semicircle intersecting the given circle at points T and T'.
6. Join P to T and P to T' to form the required tangents.
7. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

54670.subject: Technical Drawing
54670.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given isometric block (dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm) in first-angle orthographic projection. Include all hidden details.
54670.explanation:
1. Draw the front view (40 mm × 20 mm) showing height and length.
2. Draw the top view (40 mm × 30 mm) directly above the front view, showing length and depth.
3. Draw the right-side view (30 mm × 20 mm) to the right of the front view, showing depth and height.
4. Include hidden lines (dashed) for obscured edges.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

54671.subject: Technical Drawing
54671.question_text:
Given the front and top views of an object in first-angle projection, draw the missing right-side view. Include all hidden details.
(Note: Assume dimensions are provided in the diagram.)
54671.explanation:
1. Analyze the front and top views to determine the object's depth and height.
2. Project lines from the front and top views to construct the right-side view.
3. Include hidden lines (dashed) for obscured features.
4. Verify that all edges align correctly between views.
5. Label the right-side view clearly.

54672.subject: Technical Drawing
54672.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (assume a cylindrical object with a through-hole) along the cutting plane A-A. Show all section lines and hidden details.
54672.explanation:
1. Identify the cutting plane A-A on the given views.
2. Draw the sectional front view by removing the portion in front of the cutting plane.
3. Apply section lines (hatching) to the cut surfaces at 45°.
4. Include hidden lines for features behind the cutting plane.
5. Label the sectional view and cutting plane clearly.

54673.subject: Technical Drawing
54673.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block with dimensions 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm. Include all visible edges and label the isometric axes.
54673.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Mark the length (50 mm) along the 30° axis to the right.
3. Mark the width (30 mm) along the 30° axis to the left.
4. Mark the height (20 mm) vertically upward.
5. Complete the block by drawing parallel lines for the remaining edges.
6. Label the isometric axes (X, Y, Z) clearly.

54674.subject: Technical Drawing
54674.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cylinder with a diameter of 40 mm and height of 60 mm. Show all construction lines and label the dimensions.
54674.explanation:
1. Calculate the circumference of the cylinder: $C = \pi d = \pi imes 40$ mm.
2. Draw a rectangle with height = 60 mm and length = $C$ (circumference).
3. Divide the circumference into equal parts (e.g., 12) and label the points.
4. Project lines from the top and bottom edges to complete the development.
5. Label all dimensions and construction lines clearly.

54675.subject: Technical Drawing
54675.question_text: Dimension the given orthographic views (front and top) of a simple bracket. Follow standard dimensioning conventions for size and location dimensions.
54675.explanation:
1. Identify all size dimensions (e.g., lengths, diameters, radii) and location dimensions (e.g., hole centers).
2. Place size dimensions outside the views, aligned with the feature.
3. Use extension lines and dimension lines with arrowheads.
4. Place location dimensions between views where possible.
5. Avoid dimensioning to hidden lines.
6. Label all dimensions clearly with units (mm).

54676.subject: Technical Drawing
54676.question_text:
Prepare a working drawing of a simple flange coupling with the following details:
- Shaft diameter: 25 mm
- Flange diameter: 80 mm
- Flange thickness: 15 mm
- 4 holes of diameter 10 mm equally spaced on a 60 mm PCD.
Include all necessary views, dimensions, and a title block.
54676.explanation:
1. Draw the front view (sectional) and side view of the flange coupling.
2. Show the shaft, flange, and holes in the front view.
3. Include hidden lines for the holes in the side view.
4. Dimension all features: shaft diameter, flange diameter, thickness, hole diameter, and PCD.
5. Add a title block with the drawing title, scale, date, and your name.
6. Label all views and dimensions clearly.
